title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I (SAFFIRE-I)
notes: Rows F1C1/F1C2 and F2C1/F2C2 are pre-test flow-visualisation entries, not burns; their text is placed in Material (column position inferred from page order).
Page metadata lists flight platform ISS and dates 03-02-2001 to 02-28-2008 (as shown).
capture_method: Read directly from the rendered 'Experimental Table' panel of the PSI investigation page with the local browser (DOM text, viewport by viewport; table set to 100 rows/page; horizontal scrolling for wide tables). No file was downloaded; no login or registration was required. Cell text kept as displayed (runs of spaces, typos, quotes such as '"1/4"" black rod"' are the page's own text). Rows with no rendered text (paginator count minus rows saved) were not written.
